question: Which supreme deity standing in the middle of the sesame should be revealed?
premises: A deity is to be shown.
The deity stands in the middle of the sesame.
The deity is called the god of gods and upāpati.
inference: One should reveal the god of gods, upāpati, standing in the middle of the sesame.
uncertainties: upāpatim is obscure; retained as name/epithet
plain_english: One should reveal the God of gods, upāpati, standing in the middle of the sesame.
